headline: Nasdaq fut -1.9%, Kospi -3.5%, Hang Seng -3%, Brent $112.3, 10y 5.08%, OAT 10y above UST
stance: Asia sold the AI prints before New York could buy them; Treasuries are the only bid. French 10y now yields more than the US 10y, with Moody's tomorrow.

news.head: Tesla -5% pre-market (~5:30am ET): 2026 capex cut to ~$20bn
news.body: Q3 revenue $28.05bn, flat; adj EPS $0.48 vs $0.43; net income $787m, -43%. Free cash flow +$1.5bn where a $4.9bn burn was expected. Prior guide ~$25bn.

news.head: Meta -1.9% pre-market (~5am ET) on a non-voting share class
news.body: Q3 revenue $64.6bn, +26%; EPS $3.83. 2026 capex $135-145bn, floor up $5bn; Q3 free cash flow -$2.1bn. One Class C share per share held, from January 2027.

news.head: IBM -5.7%, Lam Research -8.5% pre-market (~5am ET)
news.body: IBM beat on revenue and raised its software forecast. Sold with the group: Intel -5.1%, Micron, Broadcom and Qualcomm -3% to -5%.

news.head: AT&T -6.3% Wednesday on SpaceX's consumer-mobile entry
news.body: Q3 beat on revenue and EPS with strong net adds; the stock fell on the new entrant. Southwest cut its full-year guide on jet fuel, after United and Delta.

implications: Equity is now charging for AI capex the way credit did last week: a beat with a bigger bill sells. Hyperscaler IG paper at ~105bp over Treasuries is the reference price.
French 10y above the US 10y into a rating review is a euro story too. Euro specs sit at the 1st percentile: a downgrade meets a short already extended.

watch.head: Jobless claims 8:30am; Kansas City Fed 11:00
watch.body: No tier-1 data until Friday's flash PMI and final Michigan. Fed in blackout to the Oct 28 FOMC: hike odds 16% next week, a December hike about 90% priced.

watch.head: Moody's France review tomorrow
watch.body: French yields sit at 2002 marks and the spread to Bunds at 2011 marks going in. The Assembly's revenue vote remains postponed.

watch.head: Iran: US-Israel strike plans post-midterms, per reports
watch.body: US pulled non-emergency staff from Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks; a Saudi oil field was hit overnight. Hormuz flows topped pre-war levels last week.

watch.head: Earnings: Lockheed, P&G, American before the open
watch.body: Blackstone, Spotify and Honeywell also report today. Watch jet fuel in the airline guide and whether a beat still sells.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: 10y 5.08%, -6bp; 30y 5.38%, a 4-week low (~4:45am ET). The bid came out of AI equity, not data. Wednesday's $13bn 20y tailed 1bp at 5.469%, highest since 2020.
French 10y 5.08%, above the US 10y for the first time since 2013 (~4am ET). OAT-Bund 164bp, widest since 2011. Bund 3.41%, -2bp: Germany is the haven, not France.
Brent $112.27, +3.2% (~5:45am ET): IRGC says 7 tankers hit overnight and threatens US bases over escorts. Trump: not negotiating; most expect a decision after the election.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 13: wheat specs 86th percentile, new this week, the one new extreme. Euro and sterling 1st percentile, fourth week; 5y specs 98th, sixth week: background.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Futures (~5am ET): Nasdaq 100 -1.9%, S&P -1.1%, Dow -0.7%. Asia reversed Wednesday's +1.1% Nasdaq close: Kospi -3.5%, Nikkei -2.7%, Hang Seng -3%, Hang Seng Tech -5%.
Chip equipment and memory led the selling in Tokyo, Seoul and Amsterdam. Stoxx 600 -1%, DAX -1.1% (~5am ET).
S&P closed Wednesday at 7,757, the top of its August range of 7,620-7,800. Futures -1.1% put it back mid-range: the test of the top failed before the cash open.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 13, unchanged: Russell 2000 specs 99th percentile, Nasdaq 100 97th, VIX shorts 6th. Long index, short vol, now with Kospi -3.5% and Nasdaq futures -1.9% against it.

single_name.note: Sprinklr: insider-buy rule fired, filing dated Oct 15, on the list 3 sessions. Above its 200-day; days to cover 3.5. Long setup, score 3 of 5.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HY over IG is the widest since May 2025; lowest-rated IG over triple-C the widest since 2020 (through Wednesday). Decompression, not exit.
Hyperscaler IG paper ~105bp over Treasuries, +30bp this year on supply. An issuer moved to equity funding overnight; the stock paid 2% for it pre-market.
Issuers are swapping Treasury locks for swap locks on pre-deal hedges: swap-spread swings now rival the rate move.
sections.positioning: Dealer HY inventory 28th percentile, unchanged. Low inventory into a decompression means less dealer cushion if triple-C gets hit again.
